# hallpass_agent_key (Resource)

A public key an agent signs in with. Destroying it revokes the key: connections using it end within seconds, and the key can never be registered again (on any agent), so rotate by adding a new key first. Import with `<agent_id>/<key_id>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "hallpass_agent_key" "claude_sre" {
  agent_id   = hallpass_agent.claude_sre.id
  public_key = file("~/.ssh/claude_sre_ed25519.pub")
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `agent_id` (String) Agent ID (`agt_…`). Changing it forces a new resource.
- `public_key` (String) OpenSSH public key (`ssh-ed25519 AAAA… comment`). Changing it forces a new key.

### Read-Only

- `algorithm` (String) Key algorithm.
- `fingerprint` (String) SHA-256 fingerprint.
- `id` (String) Key ID (`key_…`).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <agent_id>/<key_id>
terraform import hallpass_agent_key.claude_sre agt_01m5qh1t09e4jbmeys0q0bjz8j/key_01m5qh1t09e4jbmeys0q0bjz8k
```
